speak: Business number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year-end. Date. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Line 115. Ontario resource tax credit balance at the end of the previous tax year. Enter the amount from line 200 of Schedule 504 from the previous tax year, if applicable.

Line 120. Ontario resource tax credit balance transferred on an amalgamation or the windup of a subsidiary if subsection 87(1) or 88(1) of the federal Income Tax Act applies to the amalgamation or wind-up.
Amount 1A. Subtotal. Line 115 plus line 120. Instance 1.
Amount 1B. Ontario corporate income tax payable before tax credits. Amount 5C in Part 2 of Schedule 5 Tax Calculation Supplementary – Corporations.
Amount 1C. Ontario resource tax credit claimed in the current year. Amount 1A or 1B, whichever is less. Enter amount 1C on line 404 in Part 2 of Schedule 5.
Line 200. Ontario resource tax credit balance at the end of the tax year. Amount 1A minus amount 1C.
